title: LOGOS ASF — TR-06C Live Evaluation Plan
description: Contract for a collection of live evaluation cases against one candidate. Defines the execution-plan artifact that an operator-approved executor would later consume. In TR-06C, execution_allowed=false and executor_status=disabled. No inference occurs here.

live_eval_plan_id.description: Deterministic ID. Format: LP-<sha256[:16]>. Stable for same candidate + sorted case IDs.

candidate_artifact_id.description: The MA-* artifact this plan evaluates.

source_metadata_reports.description: TR-06A/B evaluation report IDs (ER-*) that this live eval plan builds on.

cases.description: Ordered list of live evaluation case objects. Each must conform to LIVE_EVALUATION_CASE.schema.json.

execution_allowed.description: Always false in TR-06C. Plan cannot be executed without operator-approved executor.

executor_adapter.description: Always 'disabled_stub' in TR-06C. No real provider adapter is wired.

operator_approval_required.description: Always true. Operator must approve before execution can be enabled.

promotion_blocked.description: Always true. No live eval plan can emit a promotion decision.

promotion_decision_emitted.description: Always false. TR-06C never emits a promotion decision.

blocked_actions.description: Explicit list of actions this plan cannot perform.

x-invariants.execution_disabled_const: execution_allowed is const:false. Plans cannot be executed in TR-06C.
x-invariants.executor_status_disabled_const: executor_status is const:'disabled'. No real executor is wired.
x-invariants.executor_adapter_stub_const: executor_adapter is const:'disabled_stub'. No provider adapter is active.
x-invariants.promotion_blocked_const: promotion_blocked is const:true. No plan can produce a promotion decision.
x-invariants.blocked_actions_nonempty: blocked_actions must list at least one prohibited action.
x-invariants.no_provider_calls: No provider calls occur through this plan in TR-06C.
x-invariants.no_model_weights: No model weights are referenced by path in TR-06C plans.
x-invariants.no_tr07: TR-07 shadow/canary was not started here.
x-invariants.no_training: No real training occurs in TR-06C.
